split_justification.context_rule: If the context runs short, work stops before the commit and reports, rather than leaving finished work unsecured or committing it unverified.
split_justification.reason: The owner's staged acceptance (create, halt, update, halt, delete, halt) maps to one stable functional commit per stage; a live-found functional defect creates a further functional commit with a machine-readable reason here, never an amend. The governance position exists because no decision may enter a normative commit before its id is reserved, and the mutation path may not exist before the write decision is codified.
split_justification.separation: normative and determinative stay separate; positions 2-4 are the staged functional verticals create/update/delete, each carried to its live result with an owner halt before the next
